segments.an5.44:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā vesāliyaṃ viharati mahāvane kūṭāgārasālāyaṃ.
segments.an5.44:1.2: Atha kho bhagavā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya yena uggassa gahapatino vesālikassa nivesanaṃ tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
segments.an5.44:1.3: Atha kho uggo gahapati vesāliko yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho uggo gahapati vesāliko bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.an5.44:2.1: “Sammukhā metaṃ, bhante, bhagavato sutaṃ sammukhā paṭiggahitaṃ –
segments.an5.44:2.4: taṃ me bhagavā paṭiggaṇhātu anukampaṃ upādāyā”ti.
segments.an5.44:3.1: “Sammukhā metaṃ, bhante, bhagavato sutaṃ sammukhā paṭiggahitaṃ –
segments.an5.44:3.3: Manāpaṃ me, bhante, sampannakolakaṃ sūkaramaṃsaṃ [sampannasūkaramaṃsaṃ (sī.), sampannavarasūkaramaṃsaṃ (syā.)];
segments.an5.44:3.4: taṃ me bhagavā paṭiggaṇhātu anukampaṃ upādāyā”ti.
segments.an5.44:4.1: “Sammukhā metaṃ, bhante, bhagavato sutaṃ sammukhā paṭiggahitaṃ –
segments.an5.44:4.3: Manāpaṃ me, bhante, nibbattatelakaṃ [nibaddhatelakaṃ (pī. sī. aṭṭha.), nibbaṭṭatelakaṃ (syā. aṭṭha.)] nāliyasākaṃ;
segments.an5.44:4.4: taṃ me bhagavā paṭiggaṇhātu anukampaṃ upādāyā”ti.
segments.an5.44:5.1: “Sammukhā metaṃ, bhante, bhagavato sutaṃ sammukhā paṭiggahitaṃ –
segments.an5.44:5.3: Manāpo me, bhante, sālīnaṃ odano vicitakāḷako [vigatakālako (syā. kaṃ. pī. ka.)] anekasūpo anekabyañjano;
segments.an5.44:5.4: taṃ me bhagavā paṭiggaṇhātu anukampaṃ upādāyā”ti.
segments.an5.44:6.1: “Sammukhā metaṃ, bhante, bhagavato sutaṃ sammukhā paṭiggahitaṃ –
segments.an5.44:6.4: tāni me bhagavā paṭiggaṇhātu anukampaṃ upādāyā”ti.
segments.an5.44:7.1: “Sammukhā metaṃ, bhante, bhagavato sutaṃ sammukhā paṭiggahitaṃ –
segments.an5.44:7.3: Manāpo me, bhante, pallaṅko gonakatthato paṭalikatthato kadalimigapavarapaccattharaṇo [kādalimigapavarapaccattharaṇo (sī.)] sauttaracchado ubhatolohitakūpadhāno.
segments.an5.44:7.6: Idaṃ me, bhante, candanaphalakaṃ agghati adhikasatasahassaṃ;
segments.an5.44:7.7: taṃ me bhagavā paṭiggaṇhātu anukampaṃ upādāyā”ti.
segments.an5.44:7.9: Atha kho bhagavā uggaṃ gahapatiṃ vesālikaṃ iminā anumodanīyena anumodi –
segments.an5.44:8.2: Yo ujjubhūtesu [ujubhūtesu (syā. kaṃ. pī.)] dadāti chandasā;
segments.an5.44:10.1: Atha kho bhagavā uggaṃ gahapatiṃ vesālikaṃ iminā anumodanīyena anumoditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkāmi.
segments.an5.44:11.1: Atha kho uggo gahapati vesāliko aparena samayena kālamakāsi.
segments.an5.44:11.2: Kālaṅkato [kālakato (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.)] ca uggo gahapati vesāliko aññataraṃ manomayaṃ kāyaṃ upapajji.
segments.an5.44:11.3: Tena kho pana samayena bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
segments.an5.44:11.4: Atha kho uggo devaputto abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇo kevalakappaṃ jetavanaṃ obhāsetvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi. Ekamantaṃ ṭhitaṃ kho uggaṃ devaputtaṃ bhagavā etadavoca –
segments.an5.44:11.7: Atha kho bhagavā uggaṃ devaputtaṃ gāthāhi ajjhabhāsi –

lines: Sālapupphakaṃ khādanīyanti catumadhurayojitena sālipiṭṭhena kataṃ sālapupphasadisaṃ khādanīyaṃ.
Tañhi paññāyamānavaṇṭapattakesaraṃ katvā jīrakādisambhārayutte sappimhi pacitvā sappiṃ vinivattetvā kolumbe pūretvā gandhavāsaṃ gāhāpetvā pidahitvā lañchetvā ṭhapitaṃ hoti.
Taṃ so yāguṃ pivitvā nisinnassa bhagavato antarabhatte dātukāmo evamāha.
Paṭiggahesi bhagavāti desanāmattametaṃ, upāsako pana taṃ bhagavato ca pañcannañca bhikkhusatānaṃ adāsi.
Sūkaramaṃsanti madhurarasehi badarehi saddhiṃ jīrakādisambhārehi yojetvā pakkaṃ ekasaṃvaccharikasūkaramaṃsaṃ.
Nāliyasākanti sālipiṭṭhena saddhiṃ madditvā jīrakādisaṃyutte sappimhi pacitvā catumadhurena yojetvā vāsaṃ gāhāpetvā ṭhapitaṃ nāliyasākaṃ.

Netaṃ bhagavato kappatīti ettha akappiyaṃ upādāya kappiyampi na kappatīti vuttaṃ, seṭṭhi pana sabbampi taṃ āharāpetvā rāsiṃ katvā yaṃ yaṃ akappiyaṃ, taṃ taṃ antarāpaṇaṃ pahiṇitvā kappiyaṃ upabhogaparibhogabhaṇḍaṃ adāsi.
Candanaphalakaṃ nātimahantaṃ dīghato aḍḍhateyyaratanaṃ, tiriyaṃ diyaḍḍharatanaṃ, sāravarabhaṇḍattā pana mahagghaṃ ahosi.
Bhagavā taṃ paṭiggahetvā khaṇḍākhaṇḍikaṃ chedāpetvā bhikkhūnaṃ añjanapisanatthāya dāpesi.
Aññataraṃ manomayanti suddhāvāsesu ekaṃ jhānamanena nibbattaṃ devakāyaṃ.
Tassa kira manussakāle arahattatthāya ajjhāsayo ahosi, taṃ pucchāmīti pucchati.
Devaputtopi arahattaṃ pattatāya taggha me bhagavā yathādhippāyoti āha.
Yattha yatthūpapajjatīti tīsu vā kulasampattīsu chasu vā kāmasaggesu yattha yattha uppajjati, tattha tattha dīghāyu yasavā hotīti.
Catutthe jhānamanena nibbattaṃ manomayanti āha “suddhāvāsesu ekaṃ jhānamanena nibbattaṃ devakāyan”ti.
Satipi hi sabbasattānaṃ abhisaṅkhāramanasā nibbattabhāve bāhirapaccayehi vinā manasāva nibbattattā “manomayā”ti vuccanti rūpāvacarasattā.
Yadi evaṃ kāmabhave opapātikasattānampi manomayabhāvo āpajjatīti ce?
Na, tattha bāhirapaccayehi nibbattetabbatāsaṅkāya eva abhāvato “manasāva nibbattā”ti avadhāraṇāsambhavato.
Tathā hi “annamayo, pāṇamayo, manomayo, ānandamayo, viññāṇamayo”ti pañcadhā attānaṃ vedavādinopi vadanti.
